(def nthrest
  "Returns the nth rest of coll, coll when n is 0."
  (fn [coll n]
    (if (implements? IDrop coll)
      (if (pos? n)
        (or (-drop coll (suss.bootstrap/f64-ceil n)) ())
        coll)
      (loop [n n xs coll]
        (let [s (and (pos? n) (seq xs))]
          (if s
            (recur (dec n) (rest s))
            xs))))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation (#30). Clojure 1.12 also drops through IDrop; its if-let is written as let and if, returning the remaining coll when the walk stops, and Math/ceil is the native binary64 ceiling.
